plugins.name: mailopoly
plugins.description: Mailopoly connects all your accounts at once — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud and any IMAP mailbox — and gives your AI assistant every one of them, plus Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok and X with business channels on your plan, through one connection with reading, making changes and sending as separate permissions.
